unlock.leadSetup: Choose a strong master password. Files are encrypted on disk.
unlock.leadUnlock: Enter your master password to open your encrypted vault.
unlock.fineprint: Local-only encrypted vault. No cloud sync. Signed app updates only.
unlock.pwShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.
unlock.noKey: Setup succeeded but no recovery key was returned.
unlock.confirmSaveError: Confirm that you saved the recovery key before continuing.
recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.body: This is the **only** time SecretFolder will show this key. Store it offline — it unlocks the vault if you forget the master password. Anyone with this key can open your vault.
recovery.savedCheck: I saved this recovery key somewhere safe
recovery.fineprint: Protects data at rest on disk. Does not protect a fully compromised PC while unlocked.
files.multiHint: Ctrl+click · Shift+click · drag onto folder or ..
files.selectHint: Click to select · double-click to open · Ctrl/Shift multi-select
files.parentTitle: Go to parent folder — drop items here to move up
files.parentMeta: Parent folder{extra} · drop here to move up
files.emptyRoot: Empty folder — drop files here or use Import.
files.emptyChild: Empty — drop files here, or drag items onto .. to move up.
files.folderMeta: Folder · double-click or Open · drop to move/import
files.dropImportParent: Drop to import into parent folder
files.folderSelected: Folder selected — double-click or press Open to enter.
files.selectFile: Select a file to view or edit.
files.detailHelp: Click selects · double-click opens · Ctrl/Shift multi-select. Drop OS files onto the list or a folder row to import. Drag vault items onto a folder or .. to move them.
files.binaryHint: Binary file — export to open with another app.
files.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved text changes. Leave without saving?
dialog.name: Name
delete.cascadeHelp: Empty folders first, or permanently delete everything selected (including nested contents). This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Applies immediately. The vault and your other settings stay as they are.
settings.idleHelp: Default is 15 minutes of inactivity. Set and save to change.
settings.recoveryUnchanged: Recovery key is unchanged when you change the master password.
settings.idleMin: Idle lock must be at least 1 minute.
settings.pwShort: New password must be at least 12 characters.
about.title: About
about.hello: Hi I'm Ahmi, hope this helps!
about.tagline: Local-only encrypted folder vault for Windows · MIT · v{version}
about.network: Vault data stays on this PC. Network is only for signed GitHub updates.
err.throttle: too many unlock attempts — try again in {n}s
err.pathMissing: path does not exist or cannot be resolved
err.importPath: import path must be under your home directory (Desktop, Documents, or Downloads)
err.exportIntoVault: cannot export into the SecretFolder data folder — choose another location
err.exportPath: export path must be under your home directory (Desktop, Documents, or Downloads)
err.openUrlUnsupported: open external url is only supported on Windows in v1
err.pathNotFolder: path entry is not a folder
err.moveIntoSelf: cannot move a folder into itself
err.moveIntoChild: cannot move a folder into its own subfolder
err.notText: item is not a text file
err.folderNotEmptyOne: Folder is not empty ({n} item). Empty it first, or confirm deleting everything inside.
err.folderNotEmptyMany: Folder is not empty ({n} items). Empty it first, or confirm deleting everything inside.
err.cannotExportFolder: cannot export a folder as bytes
err.versionNewer: vault format version {v} is newer than this app supports ({supported}) — upgrade SecretFolder; refusing to open so saved files are not rewritten
err.atomicReplace: atomic vault replace failed (saved files left untouched): {detail}
